cause.what_happened: On 10-09 the stock extended a slide from $4.14 (close 9-22) to about $1.61, falling 6.9% intraday on 0.52x normal volume. This was the first session after IMCC filed, at 16:06 ET on 10-08, an F-3 resale registration for 2,799,276 shares (about 170% of the 1,647,494 outstanding). Those shares sit under notes that convert at 90% of the lowest 20-day VWAP, floored at $0.40. No same-day press release or 6-K was found, so the F-3 is the cause by timing, not by an explicit headline.

evidence.claim: F-3 resale registration of 2,799,276 shares by selling shareholders (Pure Capital 1,234,642, CEO Oren Shuster 577,008, Rafi Gabay 575,557, Rocfrim 317,607, Ontario holder 94,462). It is about 170% of the 1,647,494 shares outstanding at 10-07, is not yet effective, and carries no ATM

October 7, 2026 settlement notes (US$490,770) convert at the lower of US$2.00 or 90% of the lowest daily VWAP over the 20 prior trading days, with a US$0.40 floor. They auto-convert on 2027-03-31 and are not repayable in cash
Registered direct offering of 655,000 shares at US$2.00 against a US$4.14 close on 9-22, with no placement agent. Shares outstanding went from 992,494 to 1,647,494
EDGAR atom feed: the F-3 of 10-08 16:06 ET is the latest filing. Nothing was filed on 10-09 before the screen

pipeline.next_dated_event: none found inside the window. The F-3 resale has no effectiveness date (no EFFECT filed). The four-month hold periods on the PIPE and settlement shares end from about November 2026

findings.finding: The F-3 resale prospectus filed at 16:06 ET on 2026-10-08 registers 2,799,276 shares, about 170% of shares outstanding, held by Pure Capital, the CEO and others. The underlying notes convert at 90% of the lowest 20-day VWAP, so every lower print lowers the conversion price. Monday's session (10-12) is the first after a weekend in which the full document is read.
findings.mechanism_in_window: A wider audience reads the document. It was filed after the 10-08 close and traded for one session on 0.52x volume. The weekend reader sees '170% of outstanding' and the death-spiral conversion formula on the cover and in the note terms (F-3, 2026-10-08) before the 10-12 open.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 9-23 registered direct at $2.00 (52% below the 9-22 close) the name fell -29.71% on 9-23, then +9.28%, then a run of -10.69, -12.68, -8.16, -5.99 and -4.90% drops with mostly negative next closes (baseline history.events). The 10-08 fall of -9.47% came before this F-3 was filed.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's fall came on about half normal volume ($220k against a $604k median), so the document has been traded by a thin intraday tape. Had it been fully read, today's volume would show a spike like 9-23's and not a 0.52x day. The shares cannot be sold under it until it is effective, so what can reprice is the expectation of the overhang, not actual supply.
findings.independence: The 424B5 of 2026-09-24 shows the same financiers' pattern of deeply discounted issuance (655,000 shares at $2.00 against $4.14): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1792030/000117891326004583/zk2636150.htm

findings.finding: 655,000 shares from the 9-23 registered direct (40% of outstanding) were bought at US$2.00, are registered and freely tradable, and sit about 20% underwater at $1.61. Pure Capital holds 9.99% (13G, event 9-24). That gives sellers who can act in the 10-12 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: These are registered shares that can be sold in any session, including 10-12. The resale-registration filing gives their holders a fresh reason to cut before the restricted supply behind them becomes saleable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the 9-24 closing the stock has gone from about $2.84 (9-25, per a secondary aggregator) to $1.61, with negative next closes after 7 of the 9 drops since 9-25 in the baseline events list.
findings.why_not_priced: Part of this supply has visibly been sold already, given the slide from $4.14 to $1.61, so much of it is priced. What is not is whether the remaining underwater block is spent. Nothing dates its exhaustion, and today's low volume says it has not capitulated in size.

outside_window.finding: The F-3 resale registration (2,799,276 shares) becoming effective unlocks the selling-shareholder supply. It is not effective as of 2026-10-08 and no EFFECT notice has been filed. The date is unknown and almost certainly after 10-12.
The four-month Canadian hold periods on the July, August, September and October 2026 PIPE and settlement shares expire from about November 2026 to early February 2027.
The October settlement notes auto-convert on 2027-03-31 at the lower of $2.00 or 90% of the lowest 20-day VWAP, floored at $0.40.
Q3 2026 results. The only date is the Zacks cadence estimate of 2026-11-12, not company-announced.
